title: Add delete button to remove Stripe configuration

requirements.text: Add a 'Delete Stripe Configuration' button to the StripeSetup component (frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx) that allows the admin to remove the stored Stripe API key and reset the Stripe configuration

quotes: Make a delete settings button for stripe

acceptanceCriteria: Delete button is visible in the StripeSetup component when Stripe is already configured
Button is labeled 'Delete Stripe Configuration' or similar clear text
Clicking the button shows a confirmation dialog before deletion
Confirmation dialog warns that deleting will disable payment processing
After confirmation, the button calls the backend to remove the Stripe configuration

requirements.text: Create a React Query mutation hook useDeleteStripeConfig in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that calls the backend deleteStripeConfig method and invalidates the Stripe configuration cache after successful deletion

quotes: Make a delete settings button for stripe

acceptanceCriteria: Hook is named useDeleteStripeConfig and follows the existing React Query mutation pattern
Hook requires admin authentication via the actor
After successful deletion, the hook invalidates the 'stripeConfig' query cache
Hook includes proper error handling and shows toast notifications on success/failure

requirements.text: Create a backend method deleteStripeConfig() in backend/main.mo with admin authentication that removes the stored Stripe secret key and allowed countries configuration from the StripeConfig storage

quotes: Make a delete settings button for stripe

acceptanceCriteria: Method is named deleteStripeConfig and returns a success/error result
Method requires admin authentication using requireAdmin() or equivalent
Method clears the Stripe secret key from storage
Method resets or clears the allowed countries list
After deletion, getStripeConfig should return null or empty configuration
Method includes appropriate error handling for edge cases

requirements.text: Update the StripeSetup component to refresh the configuration status after deletion and show the configuration form again when Stripe settings are removed

quotes: Make a delete settings button for stripe

acceptanceCriteria: After successful deletion, the green checkmark status indicator is hidden
The Stripe configuration form becomes visible and editable again
A success toast notification confirms the deletion
The form is ready for the admin to enter new Stripe credentials if needed

constraints: Show confirmation dialog before deleting to prevent accidental removal
Backend must properly clear all Stripe-related stored data
nonGoals: Archiving or backing up deleted Stripe configurations
Deleting historical transaction data or payment records
Notifying customers about Stripe configuration changes
Automatically disabling checkout functionality when Stripe is deleted
